skills.name: Finding details
skills.blurb: Find what the text tells you.

skills.name: Order of events
skills.blurb: Work out what happened first, next and last.

skills.name: Why it happened
skills.blurb: Link what happened to its reason.

skills.name: Feelings and reasons
skills.blurb: Read how people feel and why they act.

skills.name: Main idea
skills.blurb: Say what the text is mostly about.

skills.name: Fact or opinion
skills.blurb: Tell what can be checked from what someone thinks.

levels.name: Explorer
levels.about: Two short paragraphs, with clues to put together.

levels.name: Builder
levels.about: Texts of a few paragraphs, with details that can mislead.

levels.name: Climber
levels.about: Three paragraphs, where he and she, earlier events and reasons have to be followed.

levels.name: Challenger
levels.about: Longer texts where the answer is in different words or has to be worked out.
